exposure: FDA safety communication regarding morcellator use
time period (before and after FDA communication)
Timing of surgery relative to FDA safety communication on morcellator use
outcome: Odds ratio of abdominal myomectomy over laparoscopic myomectomy
cohort: Patients aged 18 to 55 years who underwent either laparoscopic or abdominal myomectomy (excluding malignant cases, emergency cases, operations by non-gynecologic specialists, and cases during cesarean section) from the American College of Surgeons National Surgical Quality Improvement data
finding: The odds of undergoing abdominal myomectomy over laparoscopic myomectomy increased after the FDA safety communication on morcellator use, with a disproportionately greater increase observed in the African American population.
